scope: Planning traceability only; no scenario has run by this catalog.

requirements.requirement: Prove reusable systems with independent content before authoring the full case.
Install the past incident once in normal city history, without acceptance-triggered spawning.
Provide developer starts through the same production content and movement-faithful progression.
Player and NPC traverse coherent interiors, floors, stairs and real openings.
Support timing claims with complete measured acts, uncertainty and conservative route coverage.
Witnesses see/hear only supported local events, with temporal and identity limits.
Use the shipped shared knowledge system and preserve durable learned evidence references.
Physical access, keys, consent and official scope work as ordinary reusable systems.
Objects, documents, containment, transfers and examinations preserve identity and custody.
Activities and appointments compete with ordinary duties and continue off stage.
Findings evaluate bound, supported propositions and distinguish partial conclusions.
Natural language and explicit controls use equivalent validated actions and truthful receipts.
Reading, conversation, input, menus and provider latency never pause the city.
Checkpoint the complete authoritative simulation, including pending semantic work.
Save anywhere and adopt a coherent host/sim world with durable ordered slot publication.
Fence old-world callbacks and deduplicate committed effects across save/load and retries.
Separate allegations, authority, deliveries, execution and independent custody grounds.
Issued orders reach informed executors through ordinary channels and fair bounded dispatch.
Guards search by learned leads and physically seize, escort and hand over a subject.
Correction, release, property, reputation and other proceedings remain distinct lasting outcomes.
Private admissions and restricted submissions have supported corroboration and truthful privacy.
The early physical route supports the original theft and assault without confession or surveillance.
A late player can complete the physical route without a bargain or the missed retrieval.
Surveillance observes actual object handling and supports only its warranted allegation.
Independent cry witnesses can clear Warin without identifying Corin.
Agreements, sponsorship, confidential terms and one-use services have executable obligations.
Payments, rewards and property deliveries conserve real resources and fulfil once.
Versioned content packs, actual district authoring and stable cast bindings support future authors.
New systems have measured bounded time, memory, IO and retention costs.
Release includes human comprehension/enjoyment and live-language evidence, not only fake traces.
Missed appointments, changing circumstances and absence leave truthful records and continuation.
Migrations preserve a coherent ordinary city and reconcile existing knowledge, keys and law.
Player displays distinguish unknown off-stage outcomes from known scheduled or completed events.
Findings and diagnostics cannot reveal unlearned hidden truth or causal provenance.
One shared operation/duty/resource owner controls progress, interruption and recovery.
Every later subsystem extends persistence and continuation evidence in its own milestone.
The complete case has readable operative documents, independently sourced accounts and clear stakes.
Sealed record access and physically audible speech remain separate during live audience changes.
Forged collection authority, valid pledge debt and actual redemption are distinct property states.
Station capacity, keeper coverage, hold deadlines and actual release egress are authoritative.

scenarios.title: Knowledge prerequisite
scenarios.setup_and_action: Reconcile the completed knowledge M0–M5 against current source and its own acceptance record.
scenarios.acceptance: The plan uses shipped holders, provenance, player-learning and retention APIs; no guessed duplicate store or stale quest stub remains.

scenarios.title: Authority inventory
scenarios.setup_and_action: Enumerate mutable sim/host owners, capabilities and migration seams on the actual implementation baseline.
scenarios.acceptance: Every future-affecting field has a checkpoint policy; every new shared service has one producer and explicit consumers.

scenarios.title: Reproducible baseline
scenarios.setup_and_action: Run accepted baseline suites and profile movement-faithful default/2,000-citizen runs, with 20,000 separately labeled stress.
scenarios.acceptance: Record commit/tree, hardware, poll pattern, CPU/frame/memory figures and numeric budgets. A coarse clock watcher is not movement evidence.

scenarios.title: Live overlays and conversation
scenarios.setup_and_action: Keep a conversation/floor hold and each existing menu open across movement, need and calendar transitions.
scenarios.acceptance: Simulation events and ordinary duties continue; only input capture or a particular person's permitted courtesy changes.

scenarios.title: Clock crossing ownership
scenarios.setup_and_action: Change 1×/60× immediately after bedtime and midnight while Round skips a cadence tick.
scenarios.acceptance: One office, production/settlement edge and ambient/night duty is processed; historical cursors are not reinterpreted through the new rate.

scenarios.title: No partial or duplicate action
scenarios.setup_and_action: Repeat commands, conflict their payloads, exhaust the bounded replay window and inject failed route/authority/resource validation.
scenarios.acceptance: One effect/receipt at most; rejection leaves no partial custody/inventory mutation, and compacted IDs including never-accepted requests cannot replay. M2 extends the same fixture through restore.

scenarios.title: Minimal operation kernel
scenarios.setup_and_action: Two duties claim one actor/resource; interrupt and replan during bounded in-memory work.
scenarios.acceptance: One owner, conserved completed steps and operation-wide recovery budget; replanning does not reset exhaustion. M2 adds the checkpoint continuation in V09.

scenarios.title: World and actor generations
scenarios.setup_and_action: Deliver a result for an old world and a departed incarnation with reused numeric request/actor IDs.
scenarios.acceptance: Both identity fences work independently; no current-world effect or presentation acknowledgement is accepted.

scenarios.title: Populated checkpoint
scenarios.setup_and_action: Capture M1 kernel ownership/progress and exhausted replay windows plus ordinary queues, production, offers, road parties, weather, lamps, knowledge, custody and needs mid-operation.
scenarios.acceptance: Fresh hydration resumes canonical state/events and replay rejection with controlled subsequent inputs, without new/seed paths or omitted subsystem state.

scenarios.title: Pending cognition categories
scenarios.setup_and_action: Capture an empty-inbox idle submission and a held completion followed by newer player speech.
scenarios.acceptance: Unfinished work restores one owed retry; held results apply once without resubmission; old drained history and newer obligations remain distinct.

scenarios.title: Night obligation identity
scenarios.setup_and_action: Capture queued/submitted/completed Night duties around midnight and actor departure/re-entry.
scenarios.acceptance: Owed day, incarnation and spent/completed state survive; no doubled reflection or ambient reroll, and valid retries still yield to the player.

scenarios.title: Validation and compatibility
scenarios.setup_and_action: Load valid Never sentinels, invalid floats, duplicate ownership, overflow, missing adapters and incompatible content/generator versions.
scenarios.acceptance: Virgin worlds work; invalid candidates fail with subsystem diagnostics before adoption; no defaults are silently reseeded.

scenarios.title: Capture is observation
scenarios.setup_and_action: Request repeated saves with no elapsed time, including committed receipts not yet consumed by the host.
scenarios.acceptance: No extra poll, cognition, event or physical change; all committed readable effects at the watermark belong to the capture.

scenarios.title: Matched physical capture
scenarios.setup_and_action: Save mid-jump at nonzero host/sim residual and ordinary pre-capture wall debt while a custody threshold command is queued.
scenarios.acceptance: Accepted sim pose equals the authoritative body; residuals/debt remain distinct, no offline/preparation debt is added and resistance emits its threshold effect once.

scenarios.title: Late callback storm
scenarios.setup_and_action: After adoption deliver old cognition, Night, STT, TTS, PCM, microphone/backend-status and SpeechPresented callbacks.
scenarios.acceptance: No old voice, automatic utterance or domain effect enters the loaded generation, including reused IDs.

scenarios.title: Durable ordered saves
scenarios.setup_and_action: Reverse two same-slot write completions; inject IO failures and process death after payload, recovery-reference and active-reference publication/flush steps.
scenarios.acceptance: The latest authorized durable publication wins; an acknowledged prior reference/payload remains recoverable, uncertain publication is not reported as success and retention stays bounded.

scenarios.title: Prepared adoption and retirement
scenarios.setup_and_action: Delay load preparation while the city runs, then inject staging/adoption failure and expensive old-world retirement.
scenarios.acceptance: Adoption resumes at the saved instant and swaps one coherent bundle; rollback includes clocks/UI; retirement does not create an unbudgeted frame stall.

scenarios.title: Presentation continuation
scenarios.setup_and_action: Save during speech/recording and on both sides of rat-percept and civic/well cue deadlines; later M10 extends this fixture with explicit dictation purposes and cancelled drafts.
scenarios.acceptance: Committed lines/history remain without repeated speech, unsent text stays a draft and late callbacks cannot broadcast it; semantic rat events and presented cues do not duplicate or vanish.

scenarios.title: Layered body parity
scenarios.setup_and_action: Walk player and NPC through stairs, L-corners, landings, low headroom, closed portals and vertically overlapping rooms.
scenarios.acceptance: Both use actual supported routes and consistent collision/topology; no ground flattening, wall crossing or accidental cross-floor interaction.

scenarios.title: Conservative route coverage
scenarios.setup_and_action: Add a usable roof/drop/jump or boundary shortcut absent from the ordinary NPC graph.
scenarios.acceptance: The permissive lower-bound model includes it or declines certification; graph shortest path is never mislabeled universal physical minimum.

scenarios.title: Movement-faithful advancement
scenarios.setup_and_action: Replay equal elapsed time with regular/jittered polling and a large requested development advance.
scenarios.acceptance: All accepted spans are spent in ordered substeps; route/custody/object results agree within stated tolerance and dropped spans are reported.

scenarios.title: Local perception
scenarios.setup_and_action: Put listeners/observers across walls, floors and changing doors, with vertical gaze/fog/darkness; vary arrivals during capture versus STT latency.
scenarios.acceptance: Perception follows the declared policy without radius-only witnesses; utterance-time coverage controls delayed speech, partial hearing grants no whole proposition and badges disclose no unseen audience count.

scenarios.title: Temporal sight gap
scenarios.setup_and_action: Use identical visible endpoints with an intermediate pillar occlusion, door closure or hidden exchange.
scenarios.acceptance: Continuous observation breaks; catch-up endpoints cannot grant unseen intermediate acts or restore continuity retroactively.

scenarios.title: Observable object identity
scenarios.setup_and_action: Show two similar bundles, pocket the packet or hold it as an unrendered second item.
scenarios.acceptance: A visible person does not expose hidden inventory IDs; observation tracks strengthen only through supported features/handling and later examination.

scenarios.title: Last known information
scenarios.setup_and_action: Move a person/object unseen while the player and an officer consult existing records.
scenarios.acceptance: Both retain last learned locations/times; no hidden transform or movement task leaks into their displays or leads.

scenarios.title: Keys and thresholds
scenarios.setup_and_action: Use a wrong, borrowed, copied-pattern, lost or swallowed unique key against current lock/bar states.
scenarios.acceptance: Physical match and lawful permission remain separate; identity and actual threshold state survive transfer/recovery/save.

scenarios.title: Scoped entry
scenarios.setup_and_action: Accept loft consent, then attempt rack/desk entry outside its scope or after revocation.
scenarios.acceptance: Only covered current acts proceed; later order-backed adapters use real authority and delivery rather than a warrant boolean.

scenarios.title: Keeper and loan availability
scenarios.setup_and_action: Request entry/key loan while its keeper is away, occupied or relieved.
scenarios.acceptance: A real undertaking, journey and bounded availability policy handles it; the key/keeper is not duplicated or teleported.

scenarios.title: Door operation interruption
scenarios.setup_and_action: Close/bar a portal during traversal or interrupt an opening while another operation claims it.
scenarios.acceptance: Physical state, nav revision, access receipt and resource ownership remain coherent; retries retain overall progress budgets.

scenarios.title: Unique-object lineage
scenarios.setup_and_action: Transfer, pocket, wet, transform, swallow and recover a specimen while saving across each boundary.
scenarios.acceptance: One physical identity or explicit lineage persists; neither quantity conservation nor custody history silently resets.

scenarios.title: Examination semantics
scenarios.setup_and_action: Interrupt a fracture/document comparison, swap an object revision and attempt to remove its reserved original.
scenarios.acceptance: Results identify actual method/objects/revisions; incomplete work produces no completed match, and invalidated drafts remain understandable.

scenarios.title: Readable originals and copies
scenarios.setup_and_action: Read an operative document, make an authenticated copy, then alter or lose the original.
scenarios.acceptance: The record distinguishes author, authenticity, visible text, copy act and source; possession or handwriting resemblance alone is insufficient.

scenarios.title: Duty priority and cover
scenarios.setup_and_action: Combine urgent needs, conversations, curfew, examinations, escort and post relief.
scenarios.acceptance: One arbiter owns routes/resources, maintains required cover and reports bounded interruption without inventing staff.

scenarios.title: Appointment without player
scenarios.setup_and_action: A necessary attendee is delayed while the player reads elsewhere through the meeting window.
scenarios.acceptance: The meeting uses only permitted present/recorded material, records its actual outcome and supports later business without pausing or teleporting.

scenarios.title: Complete timed demonstration
scenarios.setup_and_action: Observe departure/return but have the stand-in skip hidden work; vary mechanism load and historical sighting travel.
scenarios.acceptance: Only covered acts count; endpoints do not certify hidden steps, and the sighting interval includes actual mechanism/travel uncertainty.

scenarios.title: Finite agreements and services
scenarios.setup_and_action: Let two agreements and ordinary spending compete for the same funds; accept a calendar undertaking and single-use cargo task, interrupt and reload.
scenarios.acceptance: Actual resources fund at most one effect; outstanding obligations, finite terms and redemption persist. M9 later integrates formal disclosure/verification, exercised by V40/V58.

scenarios.title: Learned strategy triggers
scenarios.setup_and_action: Send one warning to an actor and keep an identical warning only in the player's private notes.
scenarios.acceptance: Only the actually received fact changes an allowed bounded activity strategy; off-stage deterministic duties remain independent of cognition.

scenarios.title: Minimal sufficient evidence
scenarios.setup_and_action: Remove each essential support, add duplicate retellings, and distinguish physical, admission, recovery and clearance requests.
scenarios.acceptance: Each finding downgrades correctly; opportunity, recovery, theft, assault and uncorroborated continuous presence remain distinct.

scenarios.title: Cross-case binding attack
scenarios.setup_and_action: Mix valid packets, wallet dates, statements and intervals from different incidents or named holders.
scenarios.acceptance: Shared typed actor/object/event/interval bindings prevent unrelated valid facts satisfying one conjunction.

scenarios.title: Hidden-cause noninterference
scenarios.setup_and_action: Keep admissible inputs identical but change unlearned planting, whispers and retelling histories.
scenarios.acceptance: Official findings and diagnostics stay identical until new evidence establishes the difference; no private provenance oracle appears.

scenarios.title: Autonomous supported account
scenarios.setup_and_action: With player/cognition absent, an informed NPC lodges their own account and an uninformed NPC attempts the same.
scenarios.acceptance: Only actual holdings/authorised records can be submitted; confirmation and recipients are recorded without granting hidden history.

scenarios.title: Amended findings
scenarios.setup_and_action: Confirm a false account, later correct it and reopen after save/load.
scenarios.acceptance: Old submissions stay immutable, new grounds form an amendment and downstream authority receives one explicit change event.

scenarios.title: Input parity and comprehension
scenarios.setup_and_action: Perform the same confirmed action/channel by voice, typing and controls; mis-transcribe a name and alter only hidden picker/claim data.
scenarios.acceptance: Formal actions use the same validated service, unconfirmed accusations do not lodge, already spoken words stay heard and hidden state cannot change learned choices or resolution diagnostics.

scenarios.title: Stale live draft
scenarios.setup_and_action: Keep a selected bundle open while its recipient leaves, item moves or grant changes.
scenarios.acceptance: Commit-time validation is specific, preserves drafts and does not invalidate on unrelated crowd revisions or pause the city.

scenarios.title: Sensitive audience change
scenarios.setup_and_action: Compare a perceived door opening with paired worlds differing only by an undetected listener; cancel/restore explicit dictation while its transcript is delayed.
scenarios.acceptance: Only perceived/reported changes interrupt unemitted presentation; hidden listeners do not change UI or submission outcome. Sealed delivery emits no speech, old spoken effects persist and drafts never fall back to public chat.

scenarios.title: Unknown off-stage result
scenarios.setup_and_action: The notebook stays open past review time while the reviewer is blocked elsewhere.
scenarios.acceptance: Display says the scheduled time passed with outcome unconfirmed; held/cancelled/postponed updates require a real received report.

scenarios.title: Independent authority and grounds
scenarios.setup_and_action: Return property, centrally recall a mandate still in transit, deliver recall before an older copy and request a named second valid ground.
scenarios.acceptance: Registry issuance, finite local grants, received tombstones and holds remain distinct; no psychic cancellation, wrong-order lookup, assault erasure, revived execution or deadline reset occurs.

scenarios.title: Station and hold declarations
scenarios.setup_and_action: Validate occupied stations, legacy inmates, sponsorship, deferred review and intake/handover/extension just before, exactly at and after an office cutoff.
scenarios.acceptance: Capacity/care/egress and pre-delivered defaults are explicit; exclusive cutoff is deterministic, handover preserves received recall and no delay or exact-boundary extension renews expired authority.

scenarios.title: Ordinary law migration
scenarios.setup_and_action: Disable the quest and exercise garbled-hearsay summons, witnessed watch intervention, posted fees, debt and authored inmates.
scenarios.acceptance: Each uses its proper capability/provenance; watch cause and prisoner handover meet the declared next-bell procedure; no invented finding or accidental release.

scenarios.title: Issuance to actual arrest
scenarios.setup_and_action: Issue an order with no informed executor, distant player and unavailable cognition; provide a supported lead and feasible resources.
scenarios.acceptance: Ordinary checking/delivery, assignment, search, local seizure, route escort and handover all occur through production services.

scenarios.title: Fair blocked dispatch
scenarios.setup_and_action: Queue three orders including an impossible oldest lead, a feasible later one and a stream of new ordinary work.
scenarios.acceptance: Stable age/priority and persisted retry/parking prevent starvation or monopolisation; exhausted pre-seizure claims are released.

scenarios.title: Physical pursuit and escort
scenarios.setup_and_action: Lose sight, turn L-corners, climb stairs and meet opposing escorts/temporary or permanent blockers.
scenarios.acceptance: Search uses learned leads; both bodies move within speed/collision limits, preserve overall recovery budgets and never snap through walls.

scenarios.title: Capacity and overnight cover
scenarios.setup_and_action: Two escorts compete for one intake slot while multiple arrests and Snuffing threaten keeper/post coverage.
scenarios.acceptance: Slot reservation/handover is unique, physical inmates count, available relief is real and occupied stations retain the declared care policy.

scenarios.title: Coordination races
scenarios.setup_and_action: Separate central recall from actual officer/keeper receipt during search/escort/intake; attach a second ground, race autonomous seizure and reload.
scenarios.acceptance: Distant behavior changes only after available causes; local tombstones/cutoffs remain binding, one shared execution/custody persists and independent grounds keep original deadlines.

scenarios.title: Release and booked property
scenarios.setup_and_action: Expire a hold while a door is blocked and an offered packet's booking transfer is pending; replace its keeper.
scenarios.acceptance: Legal release, restraint removal and actual egress are distinct; property custody/ownership/return claims persist with explicit failed or completed receipts.

scenarios.title: Independent author proves reuse
scenarios.setup_and_action: An author builds two differently structured disputes, including one with no offender, plus pursuit and agreement fixtures.
scenarios.acceptance: Normal UI/headless services work from data; no branch in the engine, evaluator or guard service checks a case/actor ID to make them function.

scenarios.title: Pack validation and tooling
scenarios.setup_and_action: Load packs with dangling roles, dates, references, essential inaccessible locations, missing adapters or private-fact leaks.
scenarios.acceptance: Actionable source diagnostics appear before partial installation; documented shortcuts use real services and do not patch clues into saves.

scenarios.title: Foundation continuation gate
scenarios.setup_and_action: Save/restore independent fixtures across every new subsystem, after more than 256 mints/six holdings and under declared archive-quota saturation and closed/reopened inquiries.
scenarios.acceptance: All owners extend continuation; essential/transitive evidence remains addressable without unlimited hot news, admission fails before unsupported installation and full foundation acceptance precedes Tallage content.

scenarios.title: A convincing ordinary district
scenarios.setup_and_action: Compare candidate plans/sections and traverse ordinary work, cart and pedestrian paths with the quest disabled.
scenarios.acceptance: Interiors and private links have mundane purposes; entrances/nav/collision/housing agree and the detour does not depend on invisible restrictions.

scenarios.title: Historical route certificate
scenarios.setup_and_action: Measure complete private work, conservative public alternatives, Lise's sighting endpoints and Warin's cry-alignment coverage.
scenarios.acceptance: The report meets the advance-selected margin/uncertainty relation under established historical conditions, or the strong claim remains unaccepted.

scenarios.title: One established history
scenarios.setup_and_action: Open different fresh civil dates/offices, then advance a late developer start from the same anchor, reload and discover out of order.
scenarios.acceptance: Past history and resolved future offices install once; hold expiry is independent, basic retrieval moves real property, and late/load operations never re-anchor deadlines.

scenarios.title: Operative papers and accounts
scenarios.setup_and_action: Inspect the genuine pledge, forged release, counterfoil, lodged Lise account and restricted Odo detail.
scenarios.acceptance: Exact text, parties, wallet identity/dating, unpaid balance and disclosure provenance support the promised noncircular routes without extra mandatory witnesses.

scenarios.title: Stable cast in the city
scenarios.setup_and_action: Install Mott's stable tier/duties and the existing seven-person cast with their normal homes/roles.
scenarios.acceptance: No required ambient-only reference remains, cast knowledge is intentionally seeded and ordinary occupations continue around the incident.

scenarios.title: Early physical full case
scenarios.setup_and_action: Recover the packet early; obtain origin, fracture match and the same wallet's dating, with no confession or surveillance.
scenarios.acceptance: E01's sole continuous encounter and bound authenticated chain support original theft and assault; opportunity alone is insufficient.

scenarios.title: Warin-only success
scenarios.setup_and_action: Establish Averil/Gile's independent continued observation and cry relation, then stop investigating Corin.
scenarios.acceptance: Warin can be formally cleared under the supported procedure, and the game recognises a legitimate partial achievement without inventing a culprit.

scenarios.title: Public review while life continues
scenarios.setup_and_action: Lodge partial/full bundles or leave NPCs to submit supported material while the player misses High Wick.
scenarios.acceptance: The actual review can be limited, delayed or successful; only lodged evidence counts and later records report its real outcome.

scenarios.title: Late physical recovery
scenarios.setup_and_action: Miss retrieval/review; Corin refuses wallet comparison and the bargain, Lise is absent and the rack is empty.
scenarios.acceptance: The logged fragment and retrievable wallet deposition permit comparison; its match plus Lise's prior identification of the particular desk and failed rack search permit scoped desk access before packet recovery.

scenarios.title: Private admission
scenarios.setup_and_action: Confirm named acts and independently supplied detail; contrast an established leading leak with an unlearned secret leak.
scenarios.acceptance: Only supported corroboration is certified; sealed delivery is actual, hidden histories do not become diagnostics and later established contamination can amend findings.

scenarios.title: Watch the moving packet
scenarios.setup_and_action: Follow actual retrieval, warn Corin through a real recipient, lose sight, or observe a planted/handed-over similar bundle.
scenarios.acceptance: Bounded strategy changes only from learned warnings; continuity and identity support handling at most unless further evidence establishes the original acts.

scenarios.title: Hush and sponsorship terms
scenarios.setup_and_action: Contrast legitimate sealed restitution with a hush bundle withheld even from sealed institutional delivery; let another witness disclose and miss a sponsored report.
scenarios.acceptance: Counterparties, real payments and finite terms remain distinct; third-party speech is not player breach, forbidden hush terms gain no automatic legal remedy, and sponsorship never becomes innocence or a renewed hold.

scenarios.title: Exploration and interruption
scenarios.setup_and_action: Find the passage/packet first, read through events, interrupt a search and return after a day.
scenarios.acceptance: Discovery is retained without reseeding, missed observations remain missed and at least one supported complete route still exists.

scenarios.title: Consequences happen elsewhere
scenarios.setup_and_action: Issue/amend orders while Corin, Warin and the player are in different districts; revisit after an office/day.
scenarios.acceptance: Actual dispatch, custody, release and corrections occur or remain honestly blocked; learned records distinguish orders from completed arrests.

scenarios.title: Redemption and earned service
scenarios.setup_and_action: Reject forged collection while the pledge remains unpaid, then supply genuine payment and redeem Warin's cargo favour twice.
scenarios.acceptance: No free return follows forgery alone; authorised delivery conserves tools/funds and one-use service requires real permission/resources and fulfils once.

scenarios.title: Aftermath and reopening
scenarios.setup_and_action: Let gossip/night work run, change who learns the correction, revisit Lise's conditional passage grant/restriction and reopen after loading.
scenarios.acceptance: Actual knowledge drives responses and scoped access; learned geography persists, and amendments do not reset evidence, money, actors or completed orders.

scenarios.title: Whole delivery endurance
scenarios.setup_and_action: Run representative complete paths over multiple game days and save before/after every decisive boundary.
scenarios.acceptance: Full suites and fresh-process continuation pass; retention stays bounded without dropping referenced evidence, renewing duties or losing city state.

scenarios.title: Human investigation
scenarios.setup_and_action: Observe five to eight formative testers across voice/keyboard, familiarity and slow/exploratory styles.
scenarios.acceptance: They explain their reconstruction, distinguish opportunity from identification, understand pending actions and find the spatial/social work worth doing; concrete failures drive revision.

scenarios.title: Live language boundaries
scenarios.setup_and_action: Exercise holders/non-holders, evasions, specific admissions, false accusations and disclosure with live providers.
scenarios.acceptance: Models neither invent physical results nor leak sealed history; deterministic confirmation/receipts preserve mechanics when prose varies or requests fail.

scenarios.title: Performance and compatibility release
scenarios.setup_and_action: Compare accepted reference runs at default/2,000 citizens and separate 20,000 stress, including saves, retirement and concurrent ordinary work.
scenarios.acceptance: Agreed numeric time/memory budgets and declared behavior/content compatibility pass; known baseline stress cost is separated from added multiplicative cost.
